data.text:
Dubai Holding has officially announced a groundbreaking partnership with Select Group to develop landmark projects at Dubai’s two iconic locations. This strategic move marks an exciting new chapter for Dubai’s real estate landscape. The collaboration reflects the emirate’s vision of sustainable growth and innovation within its evolving urban framework.

Select Group to Develop Landmark Projects at d3 and Palm Jebel Ali

Select Group will develop and deliver two transformative large-scale projects. At Dubai Design District (d3), the Group will create a vibrant mixed-use community that seamlessly blends culture, innovation, and contemporary urban living in one of the city’s most creative hubs. 

Meanwhile, at Palm Jebel Ali, Select Group will introduce upscale residential and hospitality developments that set new benchmarks for luxury waterfront living in this world-class destination.

Dubai Holding’s First Strategic Land Sale

Dubai Holding’s first land transaction with a third-party developer at Palm Jebel Ali development underscores the company’s commitment to generating long-term value across its world-class master-planned communities. 

In addition to Palm Jebel Ali, the strategic agreement also includes the development of new projects within the vibrant mixed-use community of Dubai Design District (d3).

In collaboration with Select Group, renowned for its prestigious developments in Dubai Marina, and Emirates Strategic Investments Company, Dubai Holding aims to redefine luxury living and dynamic community spaces.

Dubai Holding emphasized that the collaboration reinforces its commitment to enhancing long-term value across its high-caliber master developments. 

Khalid Al Malik, CEO of Dubai Holding Real Estate, echoed this sentiment, stating that the Palm Jebel Ali-Select Group partnership aligns perfectly with Dubai's vision of establishing world-class coastal destinations under the Dubai urban expansion 2040 plan for Palm Jebel Ali.

Dubai Design District (d3) Expansion

Complementing the Palm Jebel Ali project, Select Group’s Dubai Design District d3 initiative will enhance Dubai’s creative ecosystem by developing a vibrant, mixed-use community. 

Known for its innovative and design-led approach, the d3 Dubai Design District project will further solidify the area’s status as a dynamic neighborhood fostering creativity, culture, and community-driven spaces.

By combining Dubai Holding’s development expertise with Select Group’s proven track record in waterfront and lifestyle projects, the partnership will contribute to the emirate’s vision of building forward-thinking communities that balance design, innovation, and livability.

Palm Dubai United Arab Emirates’ Expansion Plan

This Palm Jebel Ali development is set to revolutionize luxury living with its upscale residential and hospitality components. Spread across seven islands over 13.4 kilometers, featuring 16 distinctive fronds and 90 kilometers of pristine beachfront, the Palm Jebel Ali luxury waterfront destination will offer unmatched panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

Select Group’s role includes developing high-end residential spaces and hospitality venues that set new standards for luxury waterfront lifestyles. With pedestrian-friendly mixed-use neighborhoods, Palm Jebel Ali aims to become a premier global waterfront destination and a key symbol of Dubai’s ambitious 2040 urban expansion strategy.

faqs.question: What type of development will Select Group deliver in Dubai Design District (d3)?

data.answer: Select Group will develop a vibrant, mixed-use community aimed at fostering creativity and culture. This significant partnership undoubtedly positions Dubai for yet another leap in its growth as a global luxury real estate and lifestyle destination.

faqs.question: What will the Palm Jebel Ali luxury waterfront development include?

data.answer: It will include upscale residential properties, hospitality venues, and pedestrian-friendly mixed-use communities offering panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

faqs.question: How extensive will Palm Jebel Ali be?

data.answer: Palm Jebel Ali will span seven islands covering 13.4 kilometers, with 16 fronds and 90 kilometers of prime beachfront.
